behavior.workerDispatch: serial staged template executor with model-managed retrieval/extraction loops
behavior.markdownStorage: one mutable document_markdown row per live document
behavior.coverageIdentity: does not require immutable Markdown content identity
behavior.phaseTwoProviderCalls: not deferred into durable server-owned work orders

performanceQualification.note: Provider latency, extraction accuracy, and end-to-end p50/p95 are intentionally measured during M4 shadow and M8/M10 canaries against the frozen corpus; M0 makes no provider call.
